# Vendored front-end files

Copied unchanged from the npm packages (source map comments removed), so the
panel needs no build step and no CDN. Update by replacing the files.

|---|---|---|
| htmx.min.js | htmx.org 2.0.11 | 0BSD (LICENSE.htmx) |
| xterm.js, xterm.css | @xterm/xterm 6.0.0 | MIT (LICENSE.xterm) |
| addon-fit.js | @xterm/addon-fit 0.11.0 | MIT (LICENSE.addon-fit) |
